chronology.anchor: First observed same-run agent conversation message; input-message fallback when no agent output exists.
chronology.offset: UTF-16 code units (JavaScript String.length); null for input-message or legacy fallback.
chronology.prefix_hash: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 observed message prefix; never replace the first anchor on later observations.
chronology.unavailable: Use a per-run fallback when message/prefix is unavailable or changed; do not fabricate engine ordering or timestamps.

native_interactions.response_replay: Same submitted answer returns its acknowledgement without native dispatch; changed input conflicts.
native_interactions.unknown_response: An in-flight attempt after timeout, disconnect or restart is fenced until an acknowledgement for that same attempt is observed. Never blindly replay.
native_interactions.observation: Request disappearance, native submission acknowledgement and run termination are separate observations; none establishes that an approved action completed.
native_interactions.privacy: Installation-owner private normalized requests and redacted answer displays only; no opaque native event or response-body log.

event.snapshot_cursor: Resume after the atomic conversation snapshot cursor; history pages are separate reads.

errors.retry: Read code, outcome and durable receipt before deciding whether another dispatch is safe.

state.cancellation: requested is intent; confirmed requires a matching terminal observation or local undispatched cancellation.
state.outcome: HTTP success and agent text do not establish a native or external effect outcome.
state.usage: Unavailable native usage remains unknown; no zero or unlimited inference is made.
state.billing: Authentication method and effective billing are distinct; no silent fallback.
state.conversational_cancellation: The native agent interprets chat/steering and calls scoped cancel_run or goal/Routine tools; new chat admission never classifies cancellation text.
state.direct_cancellation: POST /v1/runs/:id/cancel remains independent of model processing and ordinary queue delivery.
